P4 SAF Model No FE
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 0. LOAD LIBRARIES
# ============================================================
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(randomForest)

# ============================================================
# 1. FILTER DATASET (P4 ONLY, ALL YEARS)
# ============================================================
dt_data <- safety_all %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4")

# ============================================================
# 1.5 CONVERT PERCENTAGE COLUMNS TO NUMERIC (CRITICAL)
# ============================================================
percent_cols <- c(
  "Pass.Rush.Win.Percentage",
  "Pass.Rush.Pressure.Percentage",
  "Negative.Rush.Grade.Percentage",
  "Positive.Rush.Grade.Percentage",
  "Completion.Percentage.Allowed",
  "Successful.Plays.Percentage",
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage",
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage.on.Run.Plays",
  "Pass.Missed.Tackles.Percentage",
  "X15..Yards.Allowed.Percentage",
  "Percentage.of.Open.Targets",
  "Percentage.of.First.Down.or.Touchdown.Allowed",
  "Interceptions.per.Target.Coverage.Percentage",
  "Forced.Incompletion.Percentage"
)

dt_data <- dt_data %>%
  mutate(across(
    any_of(percent_cols),
    ~ as.numeric(gsub("%", "", .)) / 100
  ))


# ============================================================
# 2. DROP COVERAGE + UNWANTED FEATURES
# ============================================================
dt_data <- dt_data %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    # Identifiers
    "Player.Id", "Jersey.Number", "Player.College.GSIS",

    # Volume/context (per your request)
    "Pass.Rush.Plays",
    "Games.Won",
    "Key.Plays",
    "Defensive.Plays",
    "Negative.Plays",
    "Rush.Plays",
    "Run.Plays",
    "Coverage.Plays"
  )))

# ============================================================
# 3. PLAYER INFO (IDENTIFIERS ONLY)
# ============================================================
player_info <- dt_data %>%
  mutate(Row_ID = row_number()) %>%
  select(Row_ID, Name, Team, Season, Conference, All_Con)


# ============================================================
# 4. MODEL MATRIX (NUMERIC ONLY, KEEP ALL PLAYERS)
# ============================================================
df_model <- dt_data %>%
  mutate(Row_ID = row_number()) %>%
  select(
    Row_ID,
    All_Con,
    where(is.numeric),
    -Season
  ) %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

# Median imputation (CRITICAL FIX)
df_model <- df_model %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = -c(Row_ID, All_Con),
    .fns  = ~ ifelse(is.na(.), median(., na.rm = TRUE), .)
  ))


# ============================================================
# 5. REMOVE NEAR-ZERO VARIANCE
# ============================================================
predictors <- df_model %>% select(-Row_ID, -All_Con)

nzv <- nearZeroVar(predictors, saveMetrics = TRUE)
predictors <- predictors[, !nzv$nzv, drop = FALSE]

# ============================================================
# 6. REMOVE HIGHLY CORRELATED FEATURES
# ============================================================
cor_mat <- cor(predictors)
high_cor <- findCorrelation(cor_mat, cutoff = 0.70)

predictors <- predictors[, -high_cor, drop = FALSE]

# ============================================================
# 7. FINAL MODEL DATAFRAME
# ============================================================
df_final <- predictors %>%
  mutate(
    All_Con = df_model$All_Con,
    Row_ID  = df_model$Row_ID
  )

# ============================================================
# 8. TRAIN / TEST SPLIT (ALL YEARS)
# ============================================================
set.seed(42)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(df_final$All_Con, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

train_data <- df_final[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- df_final[-train_idx, ]

x_cols <- setdiff(names(train_data), c("All_Con", "Row_ID"))

# ============================================================
# 9. TRAIN RANDOM FOREST
# ============================================================
rf_model <- randomForest(
  x = train_data[, x_cols],
  y = as.factor(train_data$All_Con),
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = floor(sqrt(length(x_cols))),
  importance = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# 10. TEST SET PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================
test_probs <- predict(rf_model, test_data[, x_cols], type = "prob")
test_preds <- predict(rf_model, test_data[, x_cols])

test_data$Composite_Score <- test_probs[, 2]

# ============================================================
# 11. PLAYER GRADES
# ============================================================
test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 12. MERGE PLAYER INFO
# ============================================================
test_with_names <- test_data %>%
  left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID")

# ============================================================
# 13. FEATURE IMPORTANCE TABLE
# ============================================================
importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(importance(rf_model)),
  Importance = importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

print(importance_df)
view(importance_df)

# ============================================================
# 14. VISUALIZATIONS
# ============================================================
ggplot(test_data, aes(Player_Grade)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "darkgreen") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Player Grade Distribution")

ggplot(test_data, aes(Composite_Score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, fill = "darkorange", color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Composite Score Distribution")

roc_obj <- roc(test_data$All_Con, test_data$Composite_Score)
#plot(roc_obj, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve")
#auc(roc_obj)

# ============================================================
# 15. METRICS (YOUR EXACT FORMAT)
# ============================================================
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(test_preds, as.factor(test_data$All_Con))

calc_metrics <- function(cm) {
  TP <- cm$table[2, 2]
  TN <- cm$table[1, 1]
  FP <- cm$table[1, 2]
  FN <- cm$table[2, 1]

  accuracy <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
  precision <- if ((TP + FP) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FP)
  recall <- if ((TP + FN) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FN)
  specificity <- if ((TN + FP) == 0) NA else TN / (TN + FP)
  balanced_accuracy <- mean(c(recall, specificity))
  f1_score <- if ((precision + recall) == 0) NA else 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

  tibble(
    Accuracy = as.numeric(accuracy),
    Precision = precision,
    Recall = recall,
    Specificity = specificity,
    Balanced_Accuracy = balanced_accuracy,
    F1_Score = f1_score
  )
}

calc_metrics(conf_matrix)

# ============================================================
# 16. FULL DATASET PREDICTIONS (2021–2025)
# ============================================================
full_probs <- predict(rf_model, df_final[, x_cols], type = "prob")

df_final$Composite_Score <- full_probs[, 2]

full_data <- df_final %>%
  left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 17. YEAR FILTER (CHANGE THIS LINE ONLY)
# ============================================================
YEAR_TO_VIEW <- 2025

players_by_year <- full_data %>%
  filter(Season == YEAR_TO_VIEW) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Season, Composite_Score, Player_Grade)

print(players_by_year)
view(players_by_year)

# ============================================================
# FEATURE IMPORTANCE BAR PLOT
# ============================================================
ggplot(importance_df, aes(
  x = reorder(Feature, Importance),
  y = Importance
)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest Feature Importance",
    subtitle = "Mean Decrease in Gini",
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Importance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)


```

P4 Week 1
```{r}
# --- P4 Week 1 Safety Grading ---

# ---------------- 1) Prep week1 like training --------------------------
safety_week1_proc <- s_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4", Team != "ALABAMA") %>%
  mutate(
    Defensive.Snaps = ifelse(is.na(Defensive.Snaps), 1, Defensive.Snaps),
    Row_ID = row_number()
  )

# --- Comprehensive features for Safety (no "plays" or "snaps" stats) ---
model_features_safety <- c(
  # ORIGINAL IMPORTANCE PLOT FEATURES
  "Coverage.Grade",

  "Forced.Fumble",

  "Pass.Tackle.for.Loss.or.No.Gain",

  "Hits",

# --- Ensure all features exist in Safety data ---
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% names(safety_week1_proc)) {
    safety_week1_proc[[f]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
safety_input_all <- safety_week1_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_safety), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
safety_scored_all <- safety_week1_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
safety_scored_all <- safety_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week1_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    safety_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- Safety Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_safety_grade_sheet <- safety_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
```

```{r}
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {

  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly

      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
safety_scored_all <- safety_week2_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
safety_scored_all <- safety_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week2_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    safety_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- Safety Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_safety_grade_sheet <- safety_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
safety_input_all <- safety_week3_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_safety), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
safety_scored_all <- safety_week3_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
safety_scored_all <- safety_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week3_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    safety_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- Safety Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_safety_grade_sheet <- safety_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_safety_grade_sheet)
```

```{r}
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
safety_scored_all <- safety_week3_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---

  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---

  )
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
safety_input_all <- safety_week4_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_safety), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}
```

```{r}
  }

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
safety_input_all <- safety_week4_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_safety), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week4_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    safety_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- Safety Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---

  ) %>%
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
```

```{r}
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
safety_scored_all <- safety_week5_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
safety_scored_all <- safety_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week5_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    safety_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- Safety Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_safety_grade_sheet <- safety_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_safety_grade_sheet)

    all_of(setdiff(model_features_safety, c("Defensive.Grades", "Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
safety_input_all <- safety_week6_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_safety), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
safety_scored_all <- safety_week6_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
safety_scored_all <- safety_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week6_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    safety_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- Safety Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_safety_grade_sheet <- safety_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))
```

```{r}
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
safety_scored_all <- safety_week7_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
safety_scored_all <- safety_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week7_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    safety_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- Safety Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---

  ) %>%
```

```{r}
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))

  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly

      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
safety_scored_all <- safety_week8_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
safety_scored_all <- safety_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week8_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    safety_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- Safety Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_safety_grade_sheet <- safety_combined_scored %>%
```

```{r}
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
safety_input_all <- safety_week9_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_safety), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
safety_scored_all <- safety_week9_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
safety_scored_all <- safety_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week9_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    safety_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- Safety Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_safety_grade_sheet <- safety_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_safety_grade_sheet)

    all_of(setdiff(model_features_safety, c("Defensive.Grades", "Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
safety_input_all <- safety_week10_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_safety), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {

}

    )
  )
```

```{r}
  "Pass.Missed.Tackles.Percentage" = -10      # Negative - lower is better
)

# --- Ensure all features exist in Safety data ---

    safety_week10_proc[[f]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
safety_input_all <- safety_week10_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_safety), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
safety_scored_all <- safety_week10_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
safety_scored_all <- safety_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week10_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    safety_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- Safety Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_safety_grade_sheet <- safety_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_safety_grade_sheet)

    all_of(setdiff(model_features_safety, c("Defensive.Grades", "Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
```

```{r}
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
safety_scored_all <- safety_week11_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
safety_scored_all <- safety_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week11_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    safety_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- Safety Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_safety_grade_sheet <- safety_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_safety_grade_sheet)

    all_of(setdiff(model_features_safety, c("Defensive.Grades", "Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
safety_input_all <- safety_week12_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_safety), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Coverage.Grade", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(safety_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
safety_scored_all <- safety_week12_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
safety_scored_all <- safety_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week12_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    safety_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- Safety Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_safety_grade_sheet <- safety_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_safety_grade_sheet)

  ) %>%
```

```{r}
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_safety) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(safety_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
safety_scored_all <- safety_week13_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = safety_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
safety_scored_all <- safety_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week13_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    safety_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- Safety Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_safety_grade_sheet <- safety_combined_scored %>%
```

```{r}
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation

for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(safety_input_all)) {

    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

    safety_input_all[[f]][is.na(safety_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(safety_input_all, model_features_safety, feature_weights_safety)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---

  min_s <- min(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(safety_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  safety_input_all <- safety_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  safety_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
safety_combined_scored <- safety_week14_proc %>%
```
